title: Which board format and lanes should present implementation work?
question: Which board format and lanes should present implementation work?
answer:
TRACK: Recorded as: 'Owner backed up to ADR-000E / TASKBOARD.md first.' The owner did not pick an option; he said 'we need to back way up', that the six lanes he specified should be the lanes on TASKBOARD.md, and asked what they were right now.
E-1: Redirected answer: a generated TASKBOARD.json Agile Kanban board replaces TASKBOARD.md as the root contract artifact, with no TASKBOARD.md view. Six lanes (backlog, toDo, inProgress, blocked, needsReview, complete); cards keyed by WBID, no kind field; loose schema v1; owner = assignee; agents never write it. Complete cards 'stay until promoted to a durable place' and the record is deleted.
E-6: Two new v4 build Specs added to S-00O's build list, not folded into S-00P. Final order ('Yes, lets do it'): (1) WBID Spec (uppercase width 4 allocator, dual-form lookup, ADR-0041 amendment); (2) board Spec (TASKBOARD.json, lanes, lane function, sitrep; ADR-000E and ADR-0013 amendments); (3) S-00P TK-002..TK-005 rewriting controls once around the new board; (4) S-00O release.
